name: Memory
author: Stefano Coniglio
description: RAM and swap in use, measured the way systemd-oomd measures them, turning orange and then red before oomd starts killing.

barWidget.description: RAM and swap in use; click for btop, right-click for GB

schema.label: Warn at (%)
schema.description: Turn a number orange once RAM or swap use reaches this share; it turns red at 90%, where systemd-oomd kills once both pass.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: Show the share in use or the GB in use; a right click on the widget switches it.
